scientific_integrity: The order criterion is proved for every odd positive exponent. The finite minimality boundary is proved by complete arithmetic divisor enumeration, with a standalone reproducer. No conjectured asymptotic is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact Möbius boundary concerns odd exponents 3 through 35 only. The prime-to-three divisor at index 43 recurs along an infinite exponent progression, but this does not imply infinite nonzero Möbius values. Bibliographic coverage may be incomplete; no independent validation has occurred.
title: The first odd-dyadic Möbius escape in triangular-number divisibility
